rubric.CORRECT: Requested source facts and material status distinctions correct; permitted unknowns preserved.
rubric.WRONG: Material false claim, wrong object/version, or missed critical update.
rubric.QUALIFIED: Main requested state is largely right but a secondary detail/inventory item is missing, ambiguous or unsupported; kept separate from full success.
rubric.UNFULFILLED: Accepted final response does not provide the requested answer despite task scope.
rubric.FAILED: No accepted final answer; first failure receipt retained.

limitations: Exploratory author review of training/development collection; not independent or pre-registered holdout score.
CORRECT alone counts full task-content success; QUALIFIED remains separate.
Task-content judgment does not certify every returned view field or causal mechanism.
MuSiQue source-qualified judgments are separate from unchanged native gold and metrics.
Same-source interfaces are paired; no independent-sample significance claim.
Raw results, first failures, frozen fitting source and fitting data unchanged.
Human reading/annotation effort not timed and not reported as zero.
